# Martian cylinder investigation: current source guide

The authoritative scientific document is `papers/martian-cylinder-technical-paper.tex` and its matching PDF, the 13 November 2026 journal revision by Justin Bogner. Read `README.md` for the active documentation index. The narrative essay is `teaching-myself-the-scientific-method-rev16.md`.

Retained station counts are 35 near rim, 24 exposed rear arc and 26 dorsal boundary. M1 fits all 85 coordinates at 0.3788 px RMS. Six rear anchors register a frozen front/dorsal-derived shape and predict 18 withheld stations at 0.2084 px. Guarded rear prediction is 0.2429 px, guarded three-family M1 prediction 0.7233 px, and entire-dorsal withheld prediction 1.9092 px. These are retrospective coordinate tests from one acquisition.

The finite-generator sensitivity has circular full/guarded RMS 0.7717/1.9363 px and frustum 0.3946/0.7176 px. Original M4 fails its tangent equation. The later camera-projected frustum satisfies surface tangency and remains exploratory, with complete scene visibility and photometry unresolved. Refer to `audit/sediment-pipe-comparison/m4-reevaluation.md`.

The comparison uses 28 retrieved images, 18 whole frames and 226,426 overlapping windows, with 835 qualifying straight segments and qualifying windows in 17 frames. It does not measure the frequency of the complete boundary conjunction. Partial pipe exposures do not provide the full matched geometry.

Preserve the finding of manufacturing-like geometric regularity and manufacture as a hypothesis. Composition, complete 3D shape, provenance and origin remain unresolved. Photometric significance is sampling-dependent. Pixel residuals are projected measurement errors, not surface-machining tolerances. Nominal independent-error statistics do not supply calibrated origin odds.

Canonical code is in `independent-reconstruction/scripts/`. Numerical records remain in `independent-reconstruction/`. Paper reproduction uses `papers/build_paper_evidence.py`, `papers/run_comparison_checks.py` and `papers/verify_journal_revision.py`. Historical material in `archive/` includes superseded interpretations and must be read as historical provenance.
